attack: a genuine block whose tree hash was borrowed from another tree
why: the audit is bound to the tree it measured; a foreign tree stamp must be refused by name
wouldBeWrongIf: READY, or refusal by AUDIT_STALE (mtime, not content) -- that would measure when the file was written instead of what tree it names

allowedSecondary.AUDIT_ID_MISMATCH: only if the id were derived from a tree other than the one it claims
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_UNVERIFIABLE: only if the tree stamp were missing, which it is not
